_purpose: Complete per-cell compilation of the paper-swap matrix: score, purity, knob response, iterations, wall time, token breakdown, and API-list-price-equivalent cost.
_caveats: cost_usd is an API-list-price EQUIVALENT: these runs executed on subscription plans, so no per-token invoice exists. It converts measured tokens at published list rates.
wall_minutes_comparable is false for waves resumed after a provider session limit; their wall clock includes frozen intervals.
A null is a genuine absence, never a zero.
